classification: pre-registered data-lineage hardening of the frozen R380 candidate; research-only, no parameter search
question: After closing the historical HS300 membership tail and replacing the current-snapshot industry labels used by the B sleeve with the Shenwan classification effective-date history, does the frozen fade05_h30_sl20 portfolio retain its R380 performance, sealed-window advantage and 3x-cost resilience without changing strategy or portfolio parameters?

membership_gap.root_cause: The historical membership frame had no observations after 2026-10-14; the backtest helper carried the last snapshot forward for all later sessions.
membership_gap.required_repair: Fetch every missing session from 2026-10-16 through 2026-11-05 from BaoStock and verify 300 unique symbols per date before rerunning.

industry_gap.observed_semantics: The production loader reads one current ext_hy_ths snapshot and applies it to all history.
industry_gap.required_repair: Rebuild only the two B-sleeve industry fields from the Shenwan StockClassifyUse_stock effective-date history in an isolated engine root; leave all other extension fields unchanged.

frozen_design.B_variant: r371_industry_fade_5d_quality_h20_sl20 with overrides max_hold_days=30 and stop_loss=-0.20
frozen_design.B20_control_variant: r371_industry_fade_5d_quality_h20_sl20 with overrides max_hold_days=20 and stop_loss=-0.20
frozen_design.portfolio: monthly 60-day inverse-vol risk parity, 10% C cap, 15% joint equity volatility target, 60-day overlay at 15%, one-third equity-weight cap, gold 200-day trend defensive bucket

data_integrity_gates.industry_lookup_rule: For each symbol and market date, use the latest Shenwan row whose effective 计入日期 is not after the market date; use the first two digits of 行业代码 as an L1 proxy.
data_integrity_gates.industry_missing_policy: Rows without an effective industry label remain null and are excluded by the strategy filter; no current-snapshot fallback is allowed.
data_integrity_gates.industry_vintage_limit: The source workbook is an effective-date classification history, not a captured publication-vintage archive. It removes current-snapshot backfill but cannot prove that every historical revision was publicly known on its effective date.

decision_rules: Complete the data-integrity stage before reading any R381 portfolio performance.
Rerun all A, B30, B20 and three C cohorts for both 2x and 3x costs under the repaired membership and isolated effective-date industry inputs; do not reuse R380 curves.
Do not change fade, hold, stop, position count, portfolio weights, volatility targets, benchmarks, windows or costs.
If any data-integrity gate fails, do not interpret strategy performance and record a data-gap result.
If any performance or sensitivity gate fails, retain the frozen result as research-only and do not advance it to paper trading.
No leverage, no paper target, no orders and no production enablement are generated by this round.
known_limits: The Shenwan workbook provides effective dates but not a complete publication-vintage history.
Industry code first two digits are only a proxy for L1 nomenclature.

As in R119, the industry group mean is computed over the 459-symbol historical HS300 union present in alt_hs300, not only the same-day member subset; this is a fixed-universe limitation, not a current-snapshot industry fallback.
Rebuilding the B industry fields changes the historical candidate set; A and C are rerun to keep the full portfolio on one input vintage.
The sealed window remains one approximately 17-month period.
This round tests data lineage sensitivity, not a new market regime or independent alpha sample.
